stories.title: Dresden keeps up Ontario landfill battle
stories.summary: A town is pushing back on the latest step to advance a controversial landfill and transfer station project, as Premier Doug Ford's government ramps up a search for garbage space.

stories.title: Leafs’ Rielly remains out with lower-body injury
stories.summary: The Maple Leafs' injury list continues to grow.

stories.title: Teams arrive in Calgary ahead of Grey Cup final
stories.summary: The Edmonton Elks and the Montreal Alouettes arrive in Calgary today ahead of Sunday's 113th Grey Cup showdown.

stories.title: Price leads class of 2026 into Hockey Hall of Fame
stories.summary: Carey Price first visited the Hockey Hall of Fame as a teenager.

stories.title: Joey Saputo puts CF Montréal up for sale, leaving door open to relocation
stories.summary: Saputo wants the team to remain under Montreal ownership but says he won't sell at a discount or require a buyer to keep the team in the city.

stories.title: Grey Cup matchup against Edmonton brings plenty of history for Alouettes’ GM, coach
stories.summary: The Montreal Alouettes' head coach Jason Maas and general manager Danny Maciocia both have extensive experience with the Edmonton football team: 'Good friends with a lot of them.'

stories.title: Quebec prepares to weigh in on race to lead international Francophonie organization
stories.summary: The newly elected Parti Québécois government in Quebec City will soon get a chance to help choose the next leader of the international organization of French-speaking nations.

stories.title: Quebec minister ‘deeply shocked’ by more than 100 alleged fraud cases
stories.summary: Ex-Immigration Ministry bureaucrat Marilena Ida has been charged with breach of trust and document forgery after an investigation.

stories.title: Unexploded shell recovered by military along St. Lawrence River
stories.summary: The town says the shell had been submerged under a rising tide in the Port Saint-François area across the St. Lawrence River from Trois-Rivières.

stories.title: Call of the Wilde: Montreal Canadiens keep rolling with a win over the Toronto Maple Leafs
stories.summary: They haven't been at their best yet the positive results have continued. The Maple Leafs were kind enough to make it 10 straight with a point for Montreal as the Canadiens won 4-2.
